dialogues.speaker: Royinjan
dialogues.text: Ah... Though Greater Lord Rukkhadevata has long departed, she will always be the greatest deity of Sumeru.

dialogues.speaker: Royinjan
dialogues.text: She defended Sumeru from calamities and troubles and left us inexhaustible knowledge and treasures after her death.

dialogues.speaker: Royinjan
dialogues.text: So, usually, when I see an antique related to Greater Lord, I do my best to buy it and add it to my collection.
